messages:
Anya: bringing up HERA-7B for hosted catalog. need a fast quant plan + smokechecks. customer perf target: ~80ms p95 for short chat, cost target < $0.35 / 1k tokens. who can own the bring-up?
Cheng: i'll take lead on the quant experiments. suggested path: 1) fp16 baseline eval, 2) int8 (gguf) + calibration, 3) fp8 or hybrid per-layer if int8 doesn't hit quality/cost sweet spot. prioritize instruction-following tests.
Marco: +1. we should pin the calib + eval datasets upfront: use inst5k (mix code/math/multi-turn), customer_prompts_v2, and a 500-sample long context set.
Anya: Lina, can you reserve infra for two 8x A10 pools for ~48h for calib + perf sweep?
Lina: booked pool/8xa10 from 03:00-10:00 UTC tomorrow. will post access and experiment directory.
Eva: propose acceptance thresholds: relative drop vs fp16: ROUGE/accuracy < 1.5%, hallucination delta < 1%, and latency p95 <= 1.5x fp16. fallback plan is canary to a vetted 6B variant if fails.
Cheng: calibration approach: run per-channel symmetric and per-row dynamic, compare. export gguf and keep intermediate stats. quick commands:
```bash
python quantize.py --model hera-7b --target int8 --calib-dataset data/inst5k.jsonl --mode per-channel --out hera7b-int8.gguf
python eval.py --model hera7b-int8.gguf --prompts eval_prompts/instset.jsonl --metrics rouge,bert,acc
```
Marco: add tokenization sanity: `python tools/token_check.py --model hera-7b --prompts eval_prompts/instset.jsonl` to catch weird tokenizer splits.
Anya: schedule: Cheng does float baseline by EOD today; int8+calib run by EOD tomorrow; fp8 trial next week if int8 doesn't meet cost. include cost estimate in the PR (tokens/sec, $/1M tokens).
Cheng: will log throughput and memory snapshots. i'll include a small CSV in the PR with token/sec and estimated $/1M tokens for each variant.
QuantBot: AUTO: Created experiment run hera7b-int8-calib-2155012345, assigned to Cheng. Logs will stream to infra/experiments/2155012345.
Marco: eval plan: 1) automated diffs on 500 multi-turns, 2) human spot-check 30 edge cases, 3) metrics: rouge/bertscore/ppl + hallucination checklist.
Lina: infra notes: capture GPU mem/util, nvprof snapshot, dd-agent traces, and model load times. add `--trace` to the runner.
Eva: rollout strategy: canary 1% traffic on Dedicated for 24h, monitor quality/regressions, expand to 10% then 100% if green. automatic fallback to fp16 if hallucination > 1.5% or latency p95 > 2x baseline.
Anya: action items summary: Cheng (quant runs + PR + cost table), Marco (eval harness + human checklist), Lina (infra + logs), Eva (rollout policy + SLOs). Sync tomorrow 09:00 UTC. :rocket:
Cheng: acknowledged, starting baseline now.
Anya: thanks all :thumbsup:
